column1: # batch-product-inputs-v1: which product inputs each registered batch tests, read by tools/affected.cx.
# Check: sh ./unisacc.com tools/check-affected-product-inputs.cx (completeness, unknown ids, negative controls).
# kind=require  key=args placeholder; a batch whose args hold it receives a built product and must have an id row
# kind=near     key=comma list of the only placeholders a batch may hold to be narrowed by inference: such a batch
#               (materials -, no other placeholder) takes exec table edges only from the commit-tier near closure
#               (its source/use closure, its literal/arg files and one literal hop); source/use/literal/arg edges
#               keep full depth. Deeper literal-chain model names no longer pull every model table in.
# kind=id       key=batch id; inputs=comma list of repo-relative prefixes a change under which selects the batch
#               (via=declared), unioned with the batch's own near-closure dependency edges.
# Batches matching neither near nor id keep the unchanged full-depth selection.
